review: They offers a cozy atmosphere, friendly service, and a menu of tasty comfort food at reasonable prices. It’s a great spot for casual dining.

Normally the food from here is really good but we got pizza last night and it was somewhere in the range of sub par to just really not good. The whole thing was barely cooked and was so soggy. The crust was literally wet. Maybe it’s because it’s the deluxe 🤷‍♀️ 
Anyway, I don’t think we’ll be getting pizza from here again. Definitely not worth the price.

Awesome food & service! We celebrated a 90th & 70th birthday on Feb 17/24. We had 30 guests and everyone enjoyed their experience! We booked their private room. Upon returning home after paying for my bill (8 people) I realized they didn’t charge me for my meal. I called the restaurant and asked them when I could come back to pay, Julie 1st said thank you so much for being so honest then proceeded to tell me not to worry about it! ❤️ 
Now that’s customer service! 

Our guest were from Vancouver BC, Edmonton, Sylvan Lake Alberta, Saskatoon, Raymore Sask and of coarse Regina. They all raved about this restaurant! 

The service,food and atmosphere was exceptional! 

Big thanks to George, Julia, Brittany and all the chefs & kitchen staff! 

We will definitely be back for other amazing meals! 

THANK YOU COPPER KETTLE!! 
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We had dinner here after my daughter's wedding rehearsal on September 9, 2022. 

The private room was booked months in advance. Food was pre-ordered in advance for approximately 20 people.
Upon approval (on time) they were disorganized.  

I was approached and asked when we would like the buffet pizza, ribs and salad ready.  It was supposed to be ready upon our arrival.  I was told it would take 20 minutes to get it out.  It took 45 minutes.  

We had 1 waitress for our room.  I personally placed an order for 3 drinks.  I was the first person to place a drink order at 6:15.  At 6:55 I went to the bar and was very polite and said "I just want to make sure my drink order didn't get lost" There were 3 employees standing around the bar.  One older, heavy set lady with longer hair said  "why would you think it got lost? I said "because we have been waiting 40 minutes"  She proceeded to rip a strip off me.  She said in a very nasty tone with a raised voice  "sorry we're not doing good enough for you, we'll try do better ok" I was shocked. I said "really I just came to check on my drink order"  She told me to go back to the room.  I didn't even know how to respond.   Another waitress finally joined the first one.  It still took another 10 minutes for those 3 drinks (1 pop and 2 beer).  Food was decent, price was high for what we got.  Drinks were very expensive compared to what we pay elsewhere. 

When you book the room they automatically add 15% gratuity to the bill.  Lucky for them because for the service and attitude they gave I Personally wouldn't have left a tip.  

There are many other places in Regina to book a private room before you book this place.  Reading a few other reviews I'm sure I'll get a snotty reply.

Went there for a lunch.  Didn’t realize the combos were for only take out or delivery.  So they gave us the option to do take out or pay extra for dining in.  We choose to do take out.  We then got scolded by Anna saying they don’t tolerate that. And that we have to pay for our drinks and table setting.  Which is fair. BUT we never said we weren’t going to pay for our drinks or the table setting so I have a hard time understanding where this came from.  I get it they have to make their money.  But to come out and be that nasty to someone is unacceptable. This was my first time and will definitely be the last time after being treated like that.   I will say, the waitress was wonderful and apologetic for how it ended up.

Excellent experience for a group of 45! From the point of booking (Anna) the room to the service (George) to the meals everything was great! Thank you for making my Mom’s 82nd birthday a memorable dinner. The team at Copper Kettle went above and beyond.
Had a wonderful supper on the patio last weekend. Great food and service!
We ordered the Greek Patter for 4 as takeout.......it was delicious........highly recommended!

We ordered the Copper Kettle Easter Special. It was AMAZING! Each meal had lots of beautifully cooked, wonderfully moist turkey. White and dark meat. Each meal came with 2 mounds of tasty mashed potatoes and lots of crisp vegetables. On top of that there were 2 cabbage rolls and 4 perogies - also a crunchy dinner roll and a classic dessert. Oh they also sent a huge salad of interesting greens which we didn’t even get to. Leftovers! Could not recommend more highly.

We had Christmas Eve supper at your restaurant and it was a terrible experience.
When we got our turkey feast all 4 meals were cold.
When we asked why the meals are cold they said they shouldn’t be as everything is on heating trays.
This was the worst meal We have ever had especially during Christmas.
Then to top it all off they served our apple pie which was also ice cold.
What a complete and disgusting dining experience for a Christmas meal.
You should be ashamed for giving such poor service during Christmas.

Today is 19-Nov-2020, this is our Wedding Anniversary. We ordered our supper from Coper Kettle. There was some confusion, as in this crazy new world, nothing is easy anymore. Thank you Anna and staff for a great meal, and fixing the errors, and in the end being great about it. I hope that your restaurant is blessed with lasting longevity through the horrors of this pandemic.

The pitter platter is the best appetizer platter in the city. Everything is so tasty. And the fries were even still crispy after getting delivered. So good we almost ordered a second time in one night !
